## Specific task description

Task instruction: Catch the medium paymentsign with QR section from the table, rotate it, then set it back down

Task description: Operate the medium white QR-code payment sign with a base and post, slightly left of center on the table. Turn it so the QR-code side faces the robot, then return it to the table.

Success criteria: Keep the payment sign upright with its QR display face toward the robot, aligned without skew, and its base down on the table. Both grippers must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the middle of the post beneath the sign face, selecting an area with full pad contact and clearance from the face and base. Match the opening to post width to reduce collisions with upper and lower joints.
- Before closing, confirm that both fingers are actually on opposite sides of the post rather than merely overlapping in the image and pressing against its back, which could tip the payment sign over.
- When rotating, lift the base off the table and leave room for both ends of the panel and the base corners to turn. Avoid the base scraping against the table or the panel sweeping into nearby objects.
- Lower until the base rests steadily on the table before releasing, avoiding a tip-over from releasing while only one side of the base is touching.
